reason: The hypothesis directly restates the mechanism and findings from P2 and P8 (lattice distortion, packing density, cohesive energy suppressing interdiffusion) and combines them with well-known HEA concepts (configurational entropy, sluggish diffusion from P4, P17, P29, P37) to predict stability in nanoalloys. The application to nanoalloys is a minor extension without new mechanistic insight or integration of conflicting evidence, making it largely a restatement of existing results.
copied_elements: high configurational entropy stabilizes single phase
lattice distortions hinder vacancy creation and slow diffusion
sluggish diffusion reduces interdiffusion, precipitation, segregation
comparison with lower-entropy counterpart showing more interdiffusion
